title: Leveraging existing sparse point annotations for benthic imagery dense segmentation

evidence.sentence: The class inventory in this dataset is very challenging for existing generic models and appearance-based methods, as it contains near-identical colonial tunicate species, morphologically similar encrusting forms, and a heterogeneous mixed-turf category. 4.1 Overview We propose a method that given an image with a set of sparse labeled points, generates a dense semantic segmentation of the image.

We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on public benthic data and introduce a new, challenging benchmark featuring real-world sparse expert annotations, paving the way for scalable ecological analysis.
Our work addresses this gap by bridging state-of-the-art foundation models with existing sparse supervision.
